name: Geri Hahn Art MR
summary: Geri Hahn Art: Living Out Loud MR (2025) features the art of an artist-synesthete from New Jersey, who uses her cross-sensory synesthesia as a creative inspiration. The app includes music by Svetlana Rudenko (Piano) and Mads Haahr (Synths), composed to transfer the art expression into music language using a unique multisensory design approach where art palette and shapes are translated into music. Recorded talks with the artist give insights into her life in art, her inspiration and her craft of expression.
